objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and displayed in the system.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of a document; assignment of the consecutive number can be adapted.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document abbreviation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version retained or newly created during editing, release, revision, reactivation, and status changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document state such as editing, released, valid, archived, or out of force.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in a document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts, based on release of a document.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity; used for validity expiration.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which extended validity must be checked; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version that must be in Released state before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader can see a released language version.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used to document locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures within a framework, process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed special work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating new documents and used to define templates, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for a document type; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create a new document or to add information to a document.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover that can be created for uploading external files or generating new documents.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: ms_office_format
objs.description: Standard formats such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint used to generate new documents.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific descriptive data maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Document property used to link documents to master data or other documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example and document property used for linking documents.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained as a document property.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Document property maintained to enable linking and specificity.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Entity such as IT applications with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information that is released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using the system, assigned roles, authorizations, workflow tasks, distribution, acknowledgements, and notifications.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for reader authorizations, roles, distribution, archive access, and dashboards.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned at user group and person level for documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role used to provide users with functions according to their area of application.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role or assigned user that can view approved objects and dependent objects such as Attachments.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Person assigned to create or edit a document and sign the Creator workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person assigned personal change rights on a document without relevance in the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person assigned to check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for a document and its content who decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who can translate released content of the system into another language.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing sequence used for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation approval.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during workflow processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system to users about workflow tasks, status, document releases, change proposals, and validity processes.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document, created without affecting content or version history and managed in a document cockpit.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate documents that have no additional validity and start the override workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents through a workflow.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to document distribution, read authorization, notifications, acknowledgements, and dashboards.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display populated from distribution groups and used for document lists and evaluations.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, workflow status, and acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document that must be checked and released before visibility to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for a document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and document properties.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: change_document
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content or properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when released documents are changed or revised.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional Info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish Additional Info directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly because it lacks criticality.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark released Attachments for archiving and archive them with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign an author to a document and grant read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign co-authors to a document and grant personal change rights.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers to a document and grant read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers to a document and grant read and write permissions.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: System informs involved users of status, workflow tasks, document releases, change proposals, and validity processes by e-mail.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version and optionally print them as document content.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: inform_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a Change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: Notify the Creator of the proposal by e-mail after editing is documented.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete Change proposals so they are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised new version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow after attachment of the request for AKS.

evts.name: check_aks
evts.description: Check AKS through releaser or in three steps by request creator, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, keep the request for documentation, delete existing edited versions, and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents and their attachments by withdrawing authorizations rather than physical deletion.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Start the reactivation workflow automatically after a request is created.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document and retain metadata and properties maintained at AKS.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons in the distribution list for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request recipients to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of a relevant document through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards using distribution groups in the document distribution list.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches for documents according to selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated language version so it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.

External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats from an object cover.
Metadata can be maintained for a document.
Attributes and metadata are grouped into categories.
References are maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.
Documents can be linked with IT applications.

Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with master data.
Documents can be linked with other documents and local documents can reference original documents.
A document can be supplemented with Additional Info.
A document can be supplemented with Attachments.
Attachments are subject to their own versioning.
User group assignments grant reader authorizations and distribution access to documents.
Persons can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, and distribution recipients for a document.
Users belong to User Groups used for roles, readers, distribution, and archive access.
Roles are implemented to provide individual users with appropriate functions.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, and translation.
Readers can view approved documents and dependent objects.
A document has a registered author.

Reviewers are maintained in document attributes and assigned to review.
Releasers are maintained in document attributes and assigned to release.
Translation participants are assigned in the document properties dialog.
Workflow-supported processing assigns tasks to participants.
Workflow tasks are completed with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented for each released document version.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
The creator of a Change proposal receives an e-mail notification after editing is documented.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A corresponding document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
A distribution list is maintained in the cockpit for the document.
User Groups assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and notifications or tasks.
Persons assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and notifications or tasks.
Acknowledgements for documents are documented and summarized for authors or key roles.
Users in reader groups can take note of documents and confirm acknowledgements.
Documents relevant to the user are listed in the Document list dashboard.
Distribution groups in the distribution list fill user and role-specific dashboards.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
A report lists acknowledgements depending on status.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
A document can have a released translated language version.
